messages.message: Prices fell and you sold. Remember that markets fluctuate; avoid selling in a hurry.

This may be a one-off for you: you sold TECH right after it dropped 15.8%, which locked in a 18.2% loss versus your cost. That is a typical fast, emotional reaction to a sudden fall. You also decided quickly, which makes gut reactions more likely. Next time, pause one turn and ask whether anything about the asset itself has changed.
